top_signals.title: Iran War: Trump Says US Waging Economic Warfare | The Pulse 8/20/2026
top_signals.summary:
"The Pulse With Francine Lacqua" is all about conversations with high profile guests in the beating heart of global business, economics, finance and politics. Based in London, we go wherever the story is, bringing you exclusive interviews and market-moving scoops.

Today's guests: Bhanu Baweja, UBS Investment Bank, Chief Strategist; Ester Baiget, Novonesis, CEO & Selahattin Bilgen, Istanbul Airport, CEO. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Rushed CLARITY Act vote could set legislation back, Gallego warns
top_signals.summary: Gallego said the White House has not provided point-by-point feedback on a bipartisan ethics proposal as a September vote approaches.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Copper Squeeze Draws Biggest Weekly Flow to LME Sheds Since 2020
top_signals.summary: The copper stockpiles that underpin benchmark futures contracts are on track for the biggest weekly inflow since 2020, as traders rush to profit from a major supply squeeze on the London Metal Exchange.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Alibaba shares fall 2% as AI spending drives 75% drop in net income
top_signals.summary: Alibaba's U.S. listed shares were volatile in premarket trading after posting a 75% drop in net income in the June quarter.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: CapitaLand and IOI Close to Buying Singapore $1.9 Billion One Raffles Place
top_signals.summary: CapitaLand Investment Ltd. and Malaysian developer IOI Properties Group Bhd. are nearing a deal to buy an iconic office development in Singapore’s commercial center, according to people familiar with the matter.

top_signals.title: Congress can still ‘land this plane’ on crypto bill as ethics talks stall, says Democratic Sen. Gallego
top_signals.summary: Sen. Ruben Gallego says Congress can still "land this plane," referring to the Clarity Act crypto bill, as concerns grow over an unfinished ethics deal.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: The U.S.-Canada natural gas and electricity trade value rose in 2025
top_signals.summary: Although the total value of energy trade between the United States and Canada fell by 11% in 2025 to an estimated $137 billion, according to data from the U.S. Census Bureau, the trade value of natural gas and electricity between the two countries increased slightly primarily because of increased natural gas prices and trade volume.
